cond_0001.intro:
This position provides analysis and reports related to budgeting, strategic planning, activity based costing, variance, patient account and operations data, and ad-hoc analysis processes, which are used to ensure sound financial operations. This level provides decision support to management. Performs analysis on routine to moderately complex projects or programs. Management supervision is limited.
This position is responsible for providing analysis and support of operations for a facility, region, or division, or may work as part of a system-wide team. Typically this position performs analysis on moderately complex projects, following established procedures, under supervision. Works with financial systems such as Hyperion, Strata, Charge Master, Contracting, Costing, EDW, ERP, etc. Proficiency in these or similar systems is required to perform duties at this level.
cond_0001.responsibilities:
Performs specifically defined tasks related to several routine and non-routine / moderately complex functions (e.g. Operating budget, capital budget, strategic planning, patient accounts and operations). Accountable for timely and accurate completion of assigned tasks.
Provides expertise with financial systems such as Hyperion, Strata, Charge Master, Contracting, Costing, EDW, ERP, etc. To perform duties.
Coordinates the preparation and review of financial analysis, variance reports, and ad hoc reports. Collects data from various [Company name masked] data sources. Coordinates with others in gathering information, scheduling processes, and communicating issues.
Prepares financial analysis, variance reports, and ad hoc reports. Works with internal customers to develop and prepare quantitative reports in using data sources to analyze clinical and operational issues.
Performs tasks requiring more in-depth analysis to identify financial trends and economic and business forecasts of reporting outcomes and variances under moderate to minimum supervisory direction.
May coordinate and oversee data input or entry activities using knowledge of database structure and reporting capabilities.
May perform intermediate-level programming including designing, developing, and testing queries, programs, and automation procedures for collecting and reporting data using knowledge of spreadsheets and database software programs.
May create and maintain databases, using knowledge of database software, for collection and tracking of data as it relates to performance measurement.

Bachelor's degree in Accounting, Finance, or Business with two years of professional experience conducting and evaluating routine financial analysis, - OR - Master's degree in Accounting, Finance, or Business with less than two years of experience conducting and evaluating routine financial analysis. Degree must be obtained through an accredited institution. Education is verified.
Experience using word processing, spreadsheet, database, internet and e-mail, and scheduling applications.
Experience in a role requiring effective verbal, written, and interpersonal communication skills.

Masters of Accountancy Degree.
MBA.
Experience in a role requiring effective project management skills, a high degree of accuracy, and sound decision making with limited supervision.
Knowledge of [Company name masked] finances and financial processes.

This position supports analysis and reporting related to budgeting, strategic planning, activity based costing, variance, patient account and operations data, and ad-hoc analysis. The work helps ensure sound financial operations and provides decision support to management. The role involves working together on routine to moderately complex projects or programs, with limited management supervision.
This position supports operations for a facility, region, or division, or may work as part of a system-wide team. Analysis is performed on moderately complex projects, following established procedures, in coordination with others. The role works with financial systems such as Hyperion, Strata, Charge Master, Contracting, Costing, EDW, ERP, etc. Proficiency in these or similar systems is required.
cond_0342.responsibilities:
Work with the team on specifically defined tasks related to several routine and non-routine / moderately complex functions (e.g. Operating budget, capital budget, strategic planning, patient accounts and operations). Share accountability for timely and accurate completion of assigned tasks.
Support colleagues by providing expertise with financial systems such as Hyperion, Strata, Charge Master, Contracting, Costing, EDW, ERP, etc.
Coordinate the preparation and review of financial analysis, variance reports, and ad hoc reports. Collect data from various [Company name masked] data sources. Work with others in gathering information, scheduling processes, and communicating issues.
Prepare financial analysis, variance reports, and ad hoc reports. Work alongside internal customers to develop and prepare quantitative reports using data sources to analyze clinical and operational issues.
Perform tasks requiring more in-depth analysis to identify financial trends and economic and business forecasts of reporting outcomes and variances, in coordination with supervisors as needed.
May coordinate and support data input or entry activities using knowledge of database structure and reporting capabilities.
May perform intermediate-level programming including designing, developing, and testing queries, programs, and automation procedures for collecting and reporting data using knowledge of spreadsheets and database software programs.
May create and maintain databases, using knowledge of database software, for collection and tracking of data as it relates to performance measurement.
cond_0342.requirements:
Bachelor's degree in Accounting, Finance, or Business with two years of professional experience conducting and evaluating routine financial analysis, - OR - Master's degree in Accounting, Finance, or Business with less than two years of experience conducting and evaluating routine financial analysis. Degree must be obtained through an accredited institution. Education is verified.
Experience using word processing, spreadsheet, database, internet and e-mail, and scheduling applications.
Experience in a role requiring effective verbal, written, and interpersonal communication skills.
Masters of Accountancy Degree.
MBA
Experience in a role requiring effective project management skills, a high degree of accuracy, and sound decision making with limited supervision.
Knowledge of [Company name masked] finances and financial processes.
Experience in a role with budgeting and finance tracking responsibilities.

This position provides analysis and reports related to budgeting, strategic planning, activity based costing, variance, patient account and operations data, and ad-hoc analysis processes, which are used to ensure sound financial operations. This level provides decision support to management and involves regular communication with internal customers and team members. Performs analysis on routine to moderately complex projects or programs. Management supervision is limited.
This position is responsible for providing analysis and support of operations for a facility, region, or division, or may work as part of a system-wide team. Typically this position performs analysis on moderately complex projects, following established procedures, under supervision. Works with financial systems such as Hyperion, Strata, Charge Master, Contracting, Costing, EDW, ERP, etc. Proficiency in these or similar systems is required to perform duties at this level.
cond_0402.responsibilities:
Performs specifically defined tasks related to several routine and non-routine / moderately complex functions (e.g. Operating budget, capital budget, strategic planning, patient accounts and operations). Accountable for timely and accurate completion of assigned tasks.
Provides expertise with financial systems such as Hyperion, Strata, Charge Master, Contracting, Costing, EDW, ERP, etc. To perform duties.
Coordinates the preparation and review of financial analysis, variance reports, and ad hoc reports. Collects data from various [Company name masked] data sources. Actively coordinates with others in gathering information, scheduling processes, and communicating issues — staying in regular contact to keep things moving.
Prepares financial analysis, variance reports, and ad hoc reports. Works directly with internal customers on a daily basis to develop and prepare quantitative reports using data sources to analyze clinical and operational issues, explaining findings and walking them through results.
Performs tasks requiring more in-depth analysis to identify financial trends and economic and business forecasts of reporting outcomes and variances under moderate to minimum supervisory direction. Speaks up early when issues or variances are identified.
May coordinate and oversee data input or entry activities using knowledge of database structure and reporting capabilities.
May perform intermediate-level programming including designing, developing, and testing queries, programs, and automation procedures for collecting and reporting data using knowledge of spreadsheets and database software programs.
May create and maintain databases, using knowledge of database software, for collection and tracking of data as it relates to performance measurement.
cond_0402.requirements:
Minimum Requirements
Bachelor's degree in Accounting, Finance, or Business with two years of professional experience conducting and evaluating routine financial analysis, - OR - Master's degree in Accounting, Finance, or Business with less than two years of experience conducting and evaluating routine financial analysis. Degree must be obtained through an accredited institution. Education is verified.
Experience using word processing, spreadsheet, database, internet and e-mail, and scheduling applications.
Experience in a role requiring effective verbal, written, and interpersonal communication skills — including regular interaction with colleagues and internal customers.
Preferred Requirements
Masters of Accountancy Degree.
MBA.
Experience in a role requiring effective project management skills, a high degree of accuracy, and sound decision making with limited supervision.
Knowledge of [Company name masked] finances and financial processes.
Experience in a role with budgeting and finance tracking responsibilities.
